import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";
import tailwindcss from "@tailwindcss/vite";
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import { defineConfig } from "vite";
import { viteSingleFile } from "vite-plugin-singlefile";
const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
// https://vite.dev/config/
export default defineConfig({
plugins: [react(), tailwindcss(), viteSingleFile()],
resolve: {
alias: {
"@": path.resolve(__dirname, "src"),
},
},
});

import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";
import { useGameStore } from "./game/store";
import MainMenu from "./components/ui/MainMenu";
import DifficultyScreen from "./components/ui/DifficultyScreen";
import GamePage from "./components/GamePage";
export default function App() {
const screen = useGameStore((s) => s.screen);
return (
<div className="h-screen w-screen select-none overflow-hidden bg-[#070410] text-white" dir="rtl">
<AnimatePresence mode="wait">
{screen === "menu" && (
<motion.div key="menu" initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}>
<MainMenu />
</motion.div>
)}
{screen === "difficulty" && (
<motion.div key="difficulty" initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}>
<DifficultyScreen />
</motion.div>
)}
{screen === "game" && (
<motion.div key="game" initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}>
<GamePage />
</motion.div>
)}
</AnimatePresence>
</div>
);
}
import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import SceneCanvas from "./scene/SceneCanvas";
import GameScene from "./scene/GameScene";
import HUD from "./ui/HUD";
import ResultScreen from "./ui/ResultScreen";
import { useGameStore } from "../game/store";
import { DIFFICULTIES } from "../game/difficulty";
import type { RoundPhase } from "../game/types";
export default function GamePage() {
const difficulty = useGameStore((s) => s.difficulty);
const round = useGameStore((s) => s.round);
const score = useGameStore((s) => s.score);
const streak = useGameStore((s) => s.streak);
const soundOn = useGameStore((s) => s.soundOn);
const lastRoundWin = useGameStore((s) => s.lastRoundWin);
const recordRound = useGameStore((s) => s.recordRound);
const advanceRound = useGameStore((s) => s.advanceRound);
const toggleSound = useGameStore((s) => s.toggleSound);
const quitToMenu = useGameStore((s) => s.quitToMenu);
const config = DIFFICULTIES[difficulty];
const [phase, setPhase] = useState<RoundPhase>("intro");
const [showFinal, setShowFinal] = useState(false);
const handleRoundComplete = useCallback(
(win: boolean) => {
recordRound(win);
const isLastRound = round >= config.totalRounds;
setTimeout(() => {
if (isLastRound) {
setShowFinal(true);
} else {
advanceRound();
}
}, 1100);
},
[recordRound, advanceRound, round, config.totalRounds]
);
const handleQuit = () => {
setShowFinal(false);
quitToMenu();
};
return (
<div className="relative h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden bg-[#070410]">
<SceneCanvas>
{!showFinal && (
<GameScene key={round} config={config} onRoundComplete={handleRoundComplete} onPhaseChange={setPhase} />
)}
</SceneCanvas>
<HUD
round={round}
totalRounds={config.totalRounds}
score={score}
streak={streak}
soundOn={soundOn}
phase={phase}
lastRoundWin={lastRoundWin}
onToggleSound={toggleSound}
onQuit={handleQuit}
/>
{showFinal && <ResultScreen />}
</div>
);
}
import { useRef } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";
import { animated, type SpringValue } from "@react-spring/three";
import { useFrame } from "@react-three/fiber";
const AnimatedGroup = animated("group");
interface BallProps {
x: SpringValue<number>;
visible: boolean;
}
export default function Ball({ x, visible }: BallProps) {
const spin = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
const lightRef = useRef<THREE.PointLight>(null);
useFrame((state, delta) => {
if (spin.current) {
spin.current.rotation.y += delta * 1.4;
spin.current.position.y = 0.28 + Math.sin(state.clock.elapsedTime * 2.2) * 0.04;
}
if (lightRef.current) {
lightRef.current.intensity = THREE.MathUtils.damp(
lightRef.current.intensity,
visible ? 1.4 : 0,
6,
delta
);
}
});
return (
<AnimatedGroup position-x={x} position-y={0} position-z={0} visible={visible}>
<group ref={spin}>
<mesh castShadow>
<icosahedronGeometry args={[0.26, 1]} />
<meshStandardMaterial
color="#ffcf4d"
emissive="#ff8c1a"
emissiveIntensity={0.9}
metalness={0.6}
roughness={0.2}
/>
</mesh>
<pointLight ref={lightRef} color="#ffb84d" distance={2.5} intensity={0} />
</group>
</AnimatedGroup>
);
}
import { useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";
import { animated, type SpringValue } from "@react-spring/three";
import { useFrame } from "@react-three/fiber";
const AnimatedGroup = animated("group");
export type CupHighlight = "none" | "hover" | "correct" | "wrong" | "winner";
interface CupProps {
x: SpringValue<number>;
y: SpringValue<number>;
z: SpringValue<number>;
rot: SpringValue<number>;
radius?: number;
bandColor?: string;
interactive?: boolean;
highlight: CupHighlight;
onClick?: () => void;
onHoverChange?: (hover: boolean) => void;
}
export function buildCupGeometry(radius: number) {
const pts = [
new THREE.Vector2(radius * 1.0, 0),
new THREE.Vector2(radius * 1.04, 0.06),
new THREE.Vector2(radius * 0.98, 0.28),
new THREE.Vector2(radius * 0.8, 0.58),
new THREE.Vector2(radius * 0.56, 0.82),
new THREE.Vector2(radius * 0.28, 0.98),
new THREE.Vector2(radius * 0.06, 1.06),
new THREE.Vector2(0, 1.1),
];
const geo = new THREE.LatheGeometry(pts, 48);
geo.computeVertexNormals();
return geo;
}
function useCupGeometry(radius: number) {
return useMemo(() => buildCupGeometry(radius), [radius]);
}
export default function Cup({
x,
y,
z,
rot,
radius = 0.62,
bandColor = "#1dd3b0",
interactive = false,
highlight,
onClick,
onHoverChange,
}: CupProps) {
const geometry = useCupGeometry(radius);
const groupRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false);
const glowRef = useRef(0);
const targetEmissive = useMemo(() => {
switch (highlight) {
case "correct":
return new THREE.Color("#3ddc84");
case "wrong":
return new THREE.Color("#ff4d5e");
case "winner":
return new THREE.Color("#ffd24d");
case "hover":
return new THREE.Color("#ffe9a8");
default:
return new THREE.Color("#140b02");
}
}, [highlight]);
const bodyMatRef = useRef<THREE.MeshStandardMaterial>(null);
useFrame((_, delta) => {
const intensity = highlight === "none" ? 0 : highlight === "hover" ? 0.55 : 1;
glowRef.current = THREE.MathUtils.damp(glowRef.current, intensity, 6, delta);
if (bodyMatRef.current) {
bodyMatRef.current.emissive.lerp(targetEmissive, 0.15);
bodyMatRef.current.emissiveIntensity = glowRef.current * 1.4;
}
if (groupRef.current) {
const targetScale = hovered && interactive ? 1.06 : 1;
groupRef.current.scale.x = THREE.MathUtils.damp(groupRef.current.scale.x, targetScale, 8, delta);
groupRef.current.scale.y = THREE.MathUtils.damp(groupRef.current.scale.y, targetScale, 8, delta);
groupRef.current.scale.z = THREE.MathUtils.damp(groupRef.current.scale.z, targetScale, 8, delta);
}
});
return (
<AnimatedGroup
position-x={x}
position-y={y}
position-z={z}
rotation-y={rot}
onClick={(e: { stopPropagation: () => void }) => {
if (!interactive) return;
e.stopPropagation();
onClick?.();
}}
onPointerOver={(e: { stopPropagation: () => void }) => {
if (!interactive) return;
e.stopPropagation();
setHovered(true);
onHoverChange?.(true);
document.body.style.cursor = "pointer";
}}
onPointerOut={(e: { stopPropagation: () => void }) => {
if (!interactive) return;
e.stopPropagation();
setHovered(false);
onHoverChange?.(false);
document.body.style.cursor = "auto";
}}
>
<group ref={groupRef}>
<mesh geometry={geometry} castShadow receiveShadow>
<meshStandardMaterial
ref={bodyMatRef}
color="#d9ad3f"
metalness={0.85}
roughness={0.28}
emissive="#140b02"
emissiveIntensity={0}
/>
</mesh>
<mesh position={[0, 0.42, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} castShadow>
<torusGeometry args={[radius * 0.86, 0.035, 12, 48]} />
<meshStandardMaterial color={bandColor} metalness={0.4} roughness={0.35} />
</mesh>
<mesh position={[0, 1.12, 0]} castShadow>
<sphereGeometry args={[0.07, 16, 16]} />
<meshStandardMaterial color="#fff1c2" metalness={0.9} roughness={0.15} />
</mesh>
</group>
</AnimatedGroup>
);
}
import { useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";
import { useFrame } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { buildCupGeometry } from "./Cup";
import Ball from "./Ball";
import { useSpring } from "@react-spring/three";
const COLORS = ["#1dd3b0", "#2fb8d6", "#d64f8a", "#d4af37", "#8a6bff"];
function DecorCup({ index, total }: { index: number; total: number }) {
const radius = 0.56;
const geometry = useMemo(() => buildCupGeometry(radius), []);
const ref = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
const angle = (index / total) * Math.PI * 2;
const r = 2.6;
const baseX = Math.cos(angle) * r;
const baseZ = Math.sin(angle) * r;
useFrame((state) => {
if (!ref.current) return;
const t = state.clock.elapsedTime;
ref.current.position.y = 0.15 + Math.sin(t * 1.1 + index) * 0.12;
ref.current.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 0.4 + index) * 0.25;
});
return (
<group ref={ref} position={[baseX, 0.15, baseZ]}>
<mesh geometry={geometry} castShadow>
<meshStandardMaterial
color="#d9ad3f"
metalness={0.85}
roughness={0.25}
emissive={COLORS[index % COLORS.length]}
emissiveIntensity={0.18}
/>
</mesh>
<mesh position={[0, 0.42, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
<torusGeometry args={[radius * 0.86, 0.035, 12, 48]} />
<meshStandardMaterial color={COLORS[index % COLORS.length]} metalness={0.4} roughness={0.35} />
</mesh>
</group>
);
}
export default function DecorativeCups({ count = 5 }: { count?: number }) {
const ballSpring = useSpring({
x: 0,
loop: { reverse: true },
from: { x: -0.4 },
to: { x: 0.4 },
config: { duration: 2600 },
});
const groupRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
useFrame((_, delta) => {
if (groupRef.current) groupRef.current.rotation.y += delta * 0.12;
});
return (
<group ref={groupRef}>
<Ball x={ballSpring.x} visible />
{Array.from({ length: count }).map((_, i) => (
<DecorCup key={i} index={i} total={count} />
))}
</group>
);
}
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import { useSprings, useSpring } from "@react-spring/three";
import type { DifficultyConfig, RoundPhase } from "../../game/types";
import { useGameStore } from "../../game/store";
import Cup, { type CupHighlight } from "./Cup";

interface RuntimeCup {

slot: number;
lifted: boolean;
arc: number;
}
const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
interface GameSceneProps {
config: DifficultyConfig;
onRoundComplete: (win: boolean) => void;
onPhaseChange?: (phase: RoundPhase) => void;
}
export default function GameScene({ config, onRoundComplete, onPhaseChange }: GameSceneProps) {
const radius = config.cupCount <= 3 ? 0.62 : config.cupCount === 4 ? 0.56 : 0.5;
const spacing = radius * 2.7;
const n = config.cupCount;
const slotX = useCallback((slot: number) => (slot - (n - 1) / 2) * spacing, [n, spacing]);
const [phase, setPhase] = useState<RoundPhase>("intro");
const [cups, setCups] = useState<RuntimeCup[]>(() =>
Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => ({ id: i, slot: i, lifted: true, arc: 0 }))
);
const [winningId] = useState(() => Math.floor(Math.random() * n));
const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<number | null>(null);
const [hoveredId, setHoveredId] = useState<number | null>(null);
const runningRef = useRef(false);
useEffect(() => {
onPhaseChange?.(phase);
}, [phase, onPhaseChange]);
useEffect(() => {
if (runningRef.current) return;
runningRef.current = true;
let cancelled = false;
async function runShuffle() {
for (let i = 0; i < config.shuffleMoves; i++) {
if (cancelled) return;
let a = Math.floor(Math.random() * n);
let b = Math.floor(Math.random() * n);
while (b === a) b = Math.floor(Math.random() * n);
useGameStore.getState().playSfx("whoosh");
setCups((cs) => cs.map((c) => (c.slot === a || c.slot === b ? { ...c, lifted: true } : c)));
await wait(140);
if (cancelled) return;
setCups((cs) =>
cs.map((c) => {
if (c.slot === a) return { ...c, slot: b, arc: 0.8 };
if (c.slot === b) return { ...c, slot: a, arc: -0.8 };
return c;
})
);
await wait(config.swapDuration);
if (cancelled) return;
setCups((cs) => cs.map((c) => (c.slot === a || c.slot === b ? { ...c, arc: 0, lifted: false } : c)));
await wait(170);
}
}
async function run() {
await wait(1400);
if (cancelled) return;
setPhase("hiding");
setCups((cs) => cs.map((c) => ({ ...c, lifted: false })));
await wait(700);
if (cancelled) return;
setPhase("shuffling");
await runShuffle();
if (cancelled) return;
setPhase("guessing");
}
run();
return () => {
cancelled = true;
};
// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
}, []);
const springs = useSprings(
n,
cups.map((c) => ({
x: slotX(c.slot),
y: c.lifted ? 0.95 : 0,
z: c.arc,
rot: c.lifted ? 0.08 : 0,
config: { mass: 1, tension: 210, friction: 23 },
}))
);
const ballSpring = useSpring({
x: slotX(cups[winningId]?.slot ?? 0),
config: { mass: 1, tension: 170, friction: 22 },
});
const handleSelect = useCallback(
(id: number) => {
if (phase !== "guessing") return;
useGameStore.getState().playSfx("select");
setSelectedId(id);
setPhase("revealing");
setCups((cs) => cs.map((c) => ({ ...c, lifted: true })));
const win = id === winningId;
setTimeout(() => {
setPhase("done");
onRoundComplete(win);
}, 1900);
},
[phase, winningId, onRoundComplete]
);
const highlightFor = useMemo(() => {
return (id: number): CupHighlight => {
if (phase === "revealing" || phase === "done") {
if (id === selectedId && id === winningId) return "correct";
if (id === winningId) return "winner";
if (id === selectedId) return "wrong";
return "none";
}
if (phase === "guessing" && hoveredId === id) return "hover";
return "none";
};
}, [phase, selectedId, winningId, hoveredId]);
const ballVisible = phase === "intro" || phase === "revealing" || phase === "done";
return (
<group position={[0, 0.02, 0]}>
<Ball x={ballSpring.x} visible={ballVisible} />
{cups.map((c, i) => (
<Cup
key={c.id}
x={springs[i].x}
y={springs[i].y}
z={springs[i].z}
rot={springs[i].rot}
radius={radius}
bandColor={n <= 3 ? "#1dd3b0" : n === 4 ? "#2fb8d6" : "#d64f8a"}
interactive={phase === "guessing"}
highlight={highlightFor(c.id)}
onClick={() => handleSelect(c.id)}
onHoverChange={(hover) => setHoveredId(hover ? c.id : null)}
/>
))}
</group>
);
}

let ctx: AudioContext | null = null;
function getCtx(): AudioContext | null {
if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
if (!ctx) {
const AC = window.AudioContext || (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
if (!AC) return null;
ctx = new AC();
}
if (ctx.state === "suspended") {
void ctx.resume();
}
return ctx;
}
function tone(
freq: number,
duration: number,
options: { type?: OscillatorType; gain?: number; delay?: number; glideTo?: number } = {}
) {
const audioCtx = getCtx();
if (!audioCtx) return;
const { type = "sine", gain = 0.18, delay = 0, glideTo } = options;
const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
const gainNode = audioCtx.createGain();
osc.type = type;
const startTime = audioCtx.currentTime + delay;
osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, startTime);
if (glideTo) {
osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(glideTo, startTime + duration);
}
gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(0, startTime);
gainNode.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(gain, startTime + 0.02);
gainNode.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, startTime + duration);
osc.connect(gainNode);
gainNode.connect(audioCtx.destination);
osc.start(startTime);
osc.stop(startTime + duration + 0.05);
}

tone(523.25, 0.16, { gain: 0.2 });
tone(659.25, 0.16, { delay: 0.1, gain: 0.2 });
tone(783.99, 0.28, { delay: 0.2, gain: 0.22 });
tone(1046.5, 0.35, { delay: 0.32, gain: 0.22 });
},
lose: () => {
tone(300, 0.22, { type: "sawtooth", gain: 0.16, glideTo: 160 });
tone(220, 0.3, { type: "sawtooth", delay: 0.12, gain: 0.14, glideTo: 110 });
},

tone(659.25, 0.18, { delay: 0.32, gain: 0.2 });

};

streak: newStreak,

});
},
advanceRound: () => {

if (round >= config.totalRounds) {
get().playSfx("gameOver");
set({ screen: "game" });
} else {
set({ round: round + 1 });
}
},

get().playSfx("click");
set({ round: 1, score: 0, streak: 0, history: [], lastRoundWin: null });
},

get().playSfx("click");
set({ screen: "menu" });
